name: strict-testing
summary: Fails P3 without a Pact contract per component API or a mutation score of at least 80.

gates.rule: Each component API has a Pact contract file.
The mutation score from Stryker or PIT meets the minimum.

setup.note: The pack installs no test tools. You install Pact, Stryker or PIT, and Playwright MCP.

mcp-servers.name: playwright
mcp-servers.description: Playwright MCP lets the agent drive a browser to check UI behaviour during P3.

rule: UI work gets checked through Playwright MCP, and each component API keeps a Pact contract.
